summary_for_children: Al-Hashr means The Gathering. It speaks of generosity among believers, and ends with the beautiful names of Allah and the image of a mountain humbled by the Quran.
environment_concept: A great mountain, humbled (59:21), and a reading stand with the ayahs of Allah's names (59:22-24; the names are read from the verified text, not drawn in the sky).
architecture_and_scenery: A towering mountain with cracks of light, a valley of palm trees, and a calm sky where the names appear as calligraphic text only.

areas.name: Names of Allah
areas.description: The names written as text in the sky.

activities.name: Names
activities.description: Collect each name and its meaning.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Prefer others
activities.description: Carry four baskets to give to others first.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Allah is never depicted; names appear only as written words.
learning_objectives: Name some of the names in 59:22-24

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (lectern, mountain) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
